name: com.vcu-swim-lab.vr-emotion-detection
description: Predicts seven emotions from Meta Quest Pro face tracking with an on-device model (SparseVr) or Typesafe's Jev model, with optional per-player calibration.

samples.description: Contains a basic setup for using the emotion predictor
Calibrates the predictor to one player's faces, then predicts with it
On the headset: calibrate, then compare uncalibrated and calibrated predictions on the same face data
Predicts with Typesafe's Jev model. The API key is passed as a parameter (here read from the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable)
